archetypes.name: dyn-gantt-audit
archetypes.rationale: Final-report Gantt row caps and label-width filtering are the primary behavior changes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the report Gantt changes for correctness. Verify that live progress callers still use the default cap, final report round windows pass through uncapped rows, and visible-row filtering cannot shift or shrink charts incorrectly. Pay special attention to edge cases where no rows overlap or only filtered rows have long labels. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
